name: Can I build a custom home on a narrow lot in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Is a narrow lot still workable for a custom home design in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: Is a narrow lot still workable for a custom home design in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: A narrow lot can still support a custom home, but the design challenges are different from a standard parcel. The house may need a more efficient layout, vertical massing, and careful placement of stairs, windows, and parking. Construction access can also become a major issue if equipment, material deliveries, or staging space are limited. In Los Angeles, narrow lots often require more coordination with planning and building requirements because every square foot matters. Homeowners should ask early whether the lot can support the desired square footage, number of stories, garage configuration, and outdoor space. The right builder will evaluate whether the project needs a compact plan, a more efficient structural layout, or a different design approach to make the lot work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but narrow lots usually require more careful planning for setbacks, parking, light, privacy, and construction access. A narrow lot can be buildable, but the design may need to be more compact and the foundation or structural system more specialized.
